chapter: Family background and the Tulsa music scene
title: Roughhousing with band members and other bands he knew
summary: Musicians played with him; more names including Zack White, Sy Oliver and Walter Page.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I don't know. This was in Kansas City. Yeah. And Jap Allen's Cotton Pickers. I sat on the bandstand with them. I sat on the bandstand with Zack White. Oh, and I sat on the bandstand with Sy Oliver's band, but I can't recall who he had in his band. This was long before he had any idea there was a Jimmy Lunceford. He had his own band.
Did you make any friends with any of the musicians that you met on the bandstand?

Oh, they all would play with me, you know, roughhouse, you know. Rough me up, you know. Pick me up and throw me in the air and throw me from one to the other, you know. And I love it, every bit of it. And Carolina Cotton

Pickers, Walter Page and the Blue Devils, I think I mentioned earlier that he had a jazz session, and O RAN Page, Lips Page and his band, and he broke up the band and went to Kansas City and joined Basie.
And Buster Smith, one of his saxophonists retained the band in Oklahoma City. I don't know who he had in the band.
